title: ExoHub Bundle
description: Bundle manifest produced by exo bundle, describing how and when the bundle was generated with metadata about the repository, ref context, generation time, and aggregate statistics.

repo_url.description: Git remote URL of the repository (from origin)

ref.description: Resolved commit hash at which this bundle was generated

ref_name.description: Human-readable ref name (tag name, branch name, or abbreviated commit hash)

ref_type.description: Type of the ref: tag, branch, or detached commit

from_ref.description: Starting ref for the commit range (empty string if all commits are included)

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the bundle was generated (UTC)

preset.description: Name of the bundle manifest preset used

incremental.description: Whether the bundle only includes file artifacts for files modified in the commit range

commit_hashes.description: List of commit hashes included in the bundle range

commit_count.description: Number of commits in the bundle range

file_count.description: Total number of per-file artifact JSONs written

annex_file_count.description: Number of annexed files in the bundle

git_file_count.description: Number of git-only tracked files in the bundle

total_size.description: Total size in bytes of all files in the bundle

exo_version.description: Version of the exo CLI that produced the bundle
